001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.file;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.math.BigInteger;
005import java.util.Locale;
006import java.util.Objects;
007import java.util.regex.Pattern;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * A non negative amount of data in bytes, such as a maximum file size.
013 * <p>
014 * {@link #parse(String)} accepts a number followed by an optional unit, with optional
015 * whitespace around and between them. Every unit is a power of 1024 and units are case
016 * insensitive:
017 * <ul>
018 * <li>none or {@code b}: bytes</li>
019 * <li>{@code k}, {@code kb}, {@code kib}: 1024 bytes</li>
020 * <li>{@code m}, {@code mb}, {@code mib}: 1024<sup>2</sup> bytes</li>
021 * <li>{@code g}, {@code gb}, {@code gib}: 1024<sup>3</sup> bytes</li>
022 * <li>{@code t}, {@code tb}, {@code tib}: 1024<sup>4</sup> bytes</li>
023 * </ul>
024 * The number may have a decimal part using {@code .} (never {@code ,}), for example
025 * {@code 1.5GB}; a result that is not a whole number of bytes is rounded down. Every
026 * value Logback's {@code FileSize} accepts, including its optional trailing {@code s} as
027 * in {@code 10MBs}, parses to the same number of bytes. Unlike some other formats,
028 * {@code MB} never means 1000<sup>2</sup>.
029 */
030public final class DataSize implements Comparable<DataSize> {
031
032        private static final Pattern PATTERN = Pattern.compile("([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)\\s*([a-zA-Z]*)");
033
034        private static final String FORMAT_HINT = "Expected a number with an optional unit of b, k/kb/kib, m/mb/mib, g/gb/gib, or t/tb/tib (case insensitive, powers of 1024). Examples: '10MB', '512k', '1.5 GiB', '1048576'.";
035
036        private static final long KB = 1024L;
037
038        private static final long MB = KB * 1024L;
039
040        private static final long GB = MB * 1024L;
041
042        private static final long TB = GB * 1024L;
043
044        /**
045         * Zero bytes.
046         */
047        public static final DataSize ZERO = new DataSize(0);
048
049        private final long bytes;
050
051        private DataSize(long bytes) {
052                this.bytes = bytes;
053        }
054
055        /**
056         * Creates a data size from a number of bytes.
057         * @param bytes number of bytes, must not be negative.
058         * @return data size.
059         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if bytes is negative.
060         */
061        public static DataSize ofBytes(long bytes) {
062                if (bytes < 0) {
063                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Data size must not be negative. bytes: " + bytes);
064                }
065                return bytes == 0 ? ZERO : new DataSize(bytes);
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * Creates a data size from a number of kilobytes (1024 bytes each).
070         * @param kilobytes number of kilobytes, must not be negative.
071         * @return data size.
072         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if negative or too large.
073         */
074        public static DataSize ofKilobytes(long kilobytes) {
075                return ofBytes(multiply(kilobytes, KB, kilobytes + "kb"));
076        }
077
078        /**
079         * Creates a data size from a number of megabytes (1024 * 1024 bytes each).
080         * @param megabytes number of megabytes, must not be negative.
081         * @return data size.
082         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if negative or too large.
083         */
084        public static DataSize ofMegabytes(long megabytes) {
085                return ofBytes(multiply(megabytes, MB, megabytes + "mb"));
086        }
087
088        /**
089         * Creates a data size from a number of gigabytes (1024 * 1024 * 1024 bytes each).
090         * @param gigabytes number of gigabytes, must not be negative.
091         * @return data size.
092         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if negative or too large.
093         */
094        public static DataSize ofGigabytes(long gigabytes) {
095                return ofBytes(multiply(gigabytes, GB, gigabytes + "gb"));
096        }
097
098        /**
099         * Parses a data size such as {@code 10MB}, {@code 512 kb}, {@code 1.5g}, or
100         * {@code 1048576}. See the class documentation for the format.
101         * @param value text to parse.
102         * @return data size.
103         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the text is not a valid data size.
104         */
105        public static DataSize parse(String value) {
106                var m = PATTERN.matcher(value.strip());
107                if (!m.matches()) {
108                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid data size: '" + value + "'. " + FORMAT_HINT);
109                }
110                String number = Objects.requireNonNull(m.group(1));
111                String unit = Objects.requireNonNullElse(m.group(2), "");
112                long multiplier = switch (unit.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
113                        case "", "b", "s" -> 1L;
114                        case "k", "kb", "kib", "kbs" -> KB;
115                        case "m", "mb", "mib", "mbs" -> MB;
116                        case "g", "gb", "gib", "gbs" -> GB;
117                        case "t", "tb", "tib", "tbs" -> TB;
118                        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
119                                        "Invalid data size: '" + value + "'. Unknown unit '" + unit + "'. " + FORMAT_HINT);
120                };
121                BigInteger bytes = new BigDecimal(number).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(multiplier)).toBigInteger();
122                if (bytes.bitLength() >= Long.SIZE) {
123                        throw tooLarge(value);
124                }
125                return ofBytes(bytes.longValue());
126        }
127
128        private static long multiply(long number, long multiplier, String description) {
129                if (number < 0) {
130                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Data size must not be negative: '" + description + "'");
131                }
132                try {
133                        return Math.multiplyExact(number, multiplier);
134                }
135                catch (ArithmeticException e) {
136                        throw tooLarge(description);
137                }
138        }
139
140        private static IllegalArgumentException tooLarge(String value) {
141                return new IllegalArgumentException(
142                                "Data size is too large: '" + value + "'. Maximum is " + Long.MAX_VALUE + " bytes.");
143        }
144
145        /**
146         * The size in bytes.
147         * @return bytes, never negative.
148         */
149        public long toBytes() {
150                return bytes;
151        }
152
153        @Override
154        public int compareTo(DataSize o) {
155                return Long.compare(bytes, o.bytes);
156        }
157
158        @Override
159        public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
160                return obj instanceof DataSize other && other.bytes == bytes;
161        }
162
163        @Override
164        public int hashCode() {
165                return Long.hashCode(bytes);
166        }
167
168        /**
169         * A string that {@link #parse(String)} accepts, using the largest unit that divides
170         * the size exactly, for example {@code 10MB} or {@code 1500}.
171         * @return parseable text.
172         */
173        @Override
174        public String toString() {
175                if (bytes != 0) {
176                        if (bytes % TB == 0) {
177                                return (bytes / TB) + "TB";
178                        }
179                        if (bytes % GB == 0) {
180                                return (bytes / GB) + "GB";
181                        }
182                        if (bytes % MB == 0) {
183                                return (bytes / MB) + "MB";
184                        }
185                        if (bytes % KB == 0) {
186                                return (bytes / KB) + "KB";
187                        }
188                }
189                return Long.toString(bytes);
190        }
191
192}
